summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K, the US-equivalent foreign private issuer interim report, covering the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with subsequent-event disclosures. The filing addresses collateralized bitcoin and asset-backed loans, convertible notes outstanding, segment revenue by stream including self-mining and AI cloud, and a Norway acquisition earn-out. No special-situation transaction is announced: no merger, tender, spin-off, activist stake, or go-private step. It is a routine periodic update. Watch for disclosed crypto-collateral covenant terms and convertible-note maturities, which could pressure the capital structure rather than any deal catalyst.
